name: MerchCard
description: A merchandising card for a product plan — plan name, pricing, a feature list, and CTAs — used in pricing tables and plan comparisons. The highlight variant is the featured / recommended plan.

props.name: style
props.description: highlight = featured / recommended plan. Outer surface flips to surface/inverse-subtle; the card body intentionally stays a light surface in both themes (definition-level pin in Figma).

props.name: featuresList
props.description: default shows the feature list below the body; closed collapses it to the empty apron.

props.name: planName
props.description: TEXT prop `Plan Name`. Rendered as a heading — the card's accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: TEXT prop `Description`.

props.name: app
props.description: AppIcon slug for the ProductLockup header.

props.name: planLabel
props.description: ProductLockup label text (e.g. "Standard PDF toolset").

props.name: price
props.description: Main price line (e.g. "US$49.99/mo").

props.name: comparePrice
props.description: Annual/compare price line above the main price (e.g. "US$599.88/yr").

props.name: priceNote
props.description: Billing note under the price (e.g. "Billed monthly, cancel anytime").

props.name: priceTerms
props.description: Terms line (e.g. "Offer terms apply").

props.name: showPricing
props.description: BOOLEAN prop `Show Pricing`.

props.name: showOptions
props.description: BOOLEAN prop `Show Options` — toggles the options slot region.

props.name: options
props.description: SLOT `options`. When null and showOptions, renders the default SelectPromo block from optionLabel/optionPromo.

props.name: optionLabel
props.description: Default options-slot select label (e.g. "1 License").

props.name: optionPromo
props.description: Default options-slot promo caption (e.g. "Save 7.5%… See terms").

props.name: features
props.description: SLOT `features` default content — feature list items (rendered as a real <ul>).

props.name: featuresTitle
props.description: Section title above the feature list.

props.name: primaryCtaLabel
props.description: Primary (accent) CTA label.

props.name: secondaryCtaLabel
props.description: Secondary (outlined) CTA label. Hidden when empty — BOOLEAN prop `Show Secondary CTA`.

props.name: trustLabel
props.description: TrustBadge text under the CTAs (e.g. "Secure transaction").

knownTokenGaps: Body padding is 28px in Figma with no bound variable and no matching spacing token (scale jumps 24→32). Hardcoded 28px pending a Figma rebind or new token.
CTA pill radius bound to primitive --s2a-border-radius-999 in Figma; no semantic full-radius token exists yet.
--s2a-color-surface-* and --s2a-color-button-background-accent-* ship with the elastic-card-updates branch token release; fallbacks cover older token versions.

notes: Plan Name renders as an <h3> heading — the plan is announced and navigable by structure.
Feature list is a real <ul> so assistive tech announces item count.
Pricing is exposed as text, never an image.
Primary and secondary CTAs are distinct focusable actions with clear names.
Highlight is paired with structure/text, not signaled by color alone — provide a text label (e.g. 'Most popular') in content when using highlight.
Highlight body intentionally stays a light surface in both themes (Figma definition-level Light pin); verify default-card text clears 4.5:1 in both modes.
